quality_falsifier.rationale: Prospective 95-percent small-panel screening threshold, consistent with historical k10 quality-screen methodology. It is not a confidence bound or a competitor parity threshold.

acceptance: All five regenerated preparation outputs match the first closed 1M admission seals before derivation.
All native phase identities/configurations and original native, timeout, time, tee, wrapper and manager exits are authenticated; construction phases exit zero.
Baseline original exit is zero with complete MEASURED summary, selected_count=executed_count=queries=32, k=10 and denominator320.
All query results are sealed before truth reduction and native output root/request/truth seals match the frozen configuration.
Resource limits, all OOM types and pids evidence, phase deadlines, namespace isolation, cleanup, artifact hashes and instance termination pass independent replay.
Root independently applies the quality_falsifier to the closed native summary.

outcomes.execution_invalid: Missing identity/resource/closure evidence, setup defect, interrupted or timed-out execution; preserve attempt and repair demonstrated setup.
outcomes.resource_reject: Authenticated native baseline exit3 with its typed resource reason; execution INVALID must not be recast as this outcome.
outcomes.quality_reject: Complete authenticated MEASURED run below the preregistered screening threshold; preserve and diagnose routing/coverage/quantization before changing one cause.
outcomes.screen_pass: Build/publication/local-Q32 correctness and recall screen only.

next_after_screen_pass: Fresh full1000-query truth/receipt and authenticated S3 publication; matched cold resource/performance gate with an explicitly controlled cache protocol. No repeat of the already completed same100k S3 Vectors benchmark.
